jobs.description: Software Engineer, Infrastructure Hybrid in Palo Alto (Mon / Wed / Thurs) Â· $185Kâ$215K base + meaningful early-stage equity + full benefits Â About Sodalis Specialty pharmacy is where the most complex and expensive drugs reach the most in-need patients, and it still runs on faxes, phone tag, and manual data entry. Patients wait weeks for therapies that can't wait. Sodalis is building AI agents that run those operations end to end: reading and validating prescriptions, handling phone calls, and moving prescriptions through eligibility and fulfillment. The ambition goes beyond that. We want to be the rails every specialty prescription runs on, and the first system to perform clinical review at the standard of a pharmacist. We're already in production, processing tens of thousands of prescriptions a week. Backed by Gradient Ventures (Google's AI fund), and founded by veterans of Apple's Applied ML, Included Health, and Avella Specialty Pharmacy (scaled to $1.5B+ before its acquisition by OptumRx). Â The Opportunity Everything we run today is cloud-based, and so are the pharmacy management systems we integrate with. But most of the specialty pharmacy market runs on-prem. To reach it, our system has to run on the pharmacy's systems instead of ours. Whether that's the full stack on-site or a hybrid split with our cloud is one of the first decisions you'd make. That's the problem you'd own. We've never shipped an on-prem deployment, so there's no pattern to follow. You'll decide how our architecture gets packaged and deployed into environments we don't control, what has to change in our current infrastructure to make that possible, and how we maintain and see into those deployments once they're live. We don't yet know what these environments look like in detail. Some pharmacies may have restricted outbound access, legacy hardware, or IT teams that can't give us a login; others may be more open. Part of the job is going in with our customer, finding out what's actually there, and designing something that works across the range. You'll start with our AI pharmacy tech product, rolling out with a committed customer, so you build against a real deployment instead of a hypothetical one. You'd work directly with the founders and the early engineering team on the architecture. What you'll do Decide how our architecture runs in a pharmacy's environment, starting with the AI pharmacy tech product: full stack on-site, a hybrid split with our cloud, or something in between. Adapt our current infrastructure and build the packaging and deployment path that installs and updates Sodalis at each pharmacy. Own those deployments over time: upgrades, rollbacks, and observability into health and failures without being on site. Go in with our customer and pharmacy IT teams to learn what their environments actually allow, and design for the range. Partner with the founders and early engineering team on architecture. What we're looking for 5+ years in infrastructure or platform engineering. You've taken an AWS-native stack and made it run on Kubernetes or similar in environments you don't operate, including stateful services. You've shipped and maintained software running in environments you don't control: on-prem, customer-hosted, edge, or embedded. You've kept a fleet of remote installs updated, observable, and recoverable without being able to log into them. You've set the first pattern for something in a startup and are comfortable with ambiguity. You'll spend time with pharmacy IT teams and need to understand their constraints firsthand. No healthcare background required. How we work We're a handful of people going all in on a problem we think is worth it, holding a high bar and shipping work that reaches real patients. It's intense, and it isn't for everyone. We want people who want to build something that matters, alongside others who care as much as they do. If that's you, we should talk. Deep understanding of frontend architecture, state management, browser APIs, and performance. Experience building highly interactive products such as chat, collaboration, productivity, document editing, calendars, or workspaces. AI capabilities are integrated naturally into product workflows rather than added as separate chatbot experiences. Â Tech Stack TypeScript React.js / Next.js HTML / CSS WebSockets / streaming APIs Node.js REST / GraphQL APIs Â How We Work The best products today in the world were built by small, world-class teams. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite. We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us and help bring practical AI benefits to billions of users globally. jobs.title: Account Manager / Key Account Manager (m/w/d)

Als Key Account Manager machst du das für unsere größten Kunden: Unternehmensgruppen mit mehreren Gesellschaften und Standorten, vielen Entscheidern und längeren Deal Cycles. Woran wir dich nach 12 Monaten messen Dein Book trägt mehr ARR als zu Beginn: Verlängerungen, Upsell und Cross-Sell sind größer als Kündigungen und Downgrades. Als Key Account Manager: Mehr Gesellschaften und Standorte deiner Kunden arbeiten mit Cosuno, und deine großen Renewals landen dort, wo du sie vorhergesagt hast. Wer bei Cosuno erfolgreich ist Ownership. Du sprichst über eigene Fehler, bevor jemand fragt, und darüber, was du daraus geändert hast. Speed. Du löst Probleme pragmatisch und heute, nicht perfekt und nächstes Quartal. Drive. Wenn du zur Monatsmitte unter Ziel liegst, rufst du mehr Kunden an, nicht weniger. Low Ego. Du teilst, was bei dir funktioniert hat, damit das Team besser wird. Diese Rolle ist für dich, wenn du ein Book mit vielen Kunden lieber selbst steuerst, als fünf Großkunden zu betreuen. du Verlängerungen verhandelst und dabei den Preis hältst, statt Rabatt zu geben. du schon einmal den echten Kündigungsgrund hinter dem genannten gefunden hast. du deine Zahlen kennst und sie dich motivieren. du mit Geschäftsführern im Mittelstand auf Augenhöhe sprichst und verstehen willst, wie am Bau eingekauft wird. Diese Rolle ist nichts für dich, wenn du Customer Success als Beziehungspflege verstehst und Verkaufen vermeidest. du aus Support, Service oder reinem Onboarding kommst und noch nie eine eigene Zielzahl hattest. du zehn Enterprise-Accounts gewohnt bist und 70 Kunden als zu viel empfindest. du lieber über Transformation präsentierst, als einen Vertrag zu verlängern. Harte Anforderungen Rund 2 bis 3 Jahre im Account Management, Customer Success oder Sales im B2B-Umfeld, idealerweise SaaS, davon mindestens ein Jahr mit eigener Verantwortung für Bestandskunden und Umsatz. Belegbare Ergebnisse bei Verlängerungen, Upsell oder Kündigungen in den letzten Perioden. Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau. Gutes Englisch und Erfahrung mit B

Du machst seit Jahren fundierte und pragmatische KYC- und AML-Arbeit und bist bereit, mehr zu verantworten, als die Karriereleiter über dir zulässt? Du möchtest mit modernen Tools und KI am Puls der Zeit in einem dynamischen Team arbeiten? Dann ist diese Rolle für dich! “KYC/AML Services” ist Vestlanes jüngstes Team, das die operative KYC- und AML-Arbeit für Fonds- und Asset Manager-Kunden in Deutschland, Großbritannien und Luxemburg erbringt. Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem Head of KYC & AML Operations zusammen und übernimmst echte Verantwortung ab Tag eins und hast direkten Investoren- und Kundenkontakt. Deinen Entwicklungspfad gestaltest du aktiv mit, erfolgsabhängig, statt getrieben vom nächsten Beförderungszyklus. Deine Aufgaben Investorenakten von A bis Z: Du führst KYC-Prüfungen, Risikobewertungen und Enhanced Due Diligence für Investoren und Assets in Fondsstrukturen in Deutschland, Großbritannien und Luxemburg durch – mithilfe unserer KI-gestützten, digitalen Plattform. Screening-Treffer bearbeiten: Du bewertest und dokumentierst Treffer aus Namens-, Sanktions- und Adverse-Media-Screening und bereitest klare, entscheidungsreife Bewertungen vor – mithilfe nativer KI-Agenten. Geldwäschebeauftragte der Kunden unterstützen: Du erstellst Eskalationsvermerke und Reportings, damit Geldwäschebeauftragte und Responsables du Contrôle unserer Kunden auf solider Grundlage entscheiden können. Die Maschine mitbauen: Du wirkst an Policies, Checklisten, QA-Standards und Tooling unserer Abteilung aktiv mit. Du hinterfragst kritisch, denkst Prozesse neu. Du willst KYC/AML als Geschäftschance verstehen und nicht als Last. Das Produkt verbessern: Du zeigst auf, wo die Vestlane-Plattform KYC-Arbeit schneller und sicherer machen kann, und setzt das gemeinsam mit unserem Produktteam um. Dein Profil Mindestens 3 Jahre operative KYC/AML- oder vergleichbare Erfahrung, etwa bei einer Big-4- oder Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaft, einem Fondsadministrator, einer KYC/AML-Beratung oder in der AML-Funktion eines Fonds oder Finanzinstituts. Sichere Kenntnisse des deutschen und des Luxemburger Rechtsrahmens: GwG und BaFin-Auslegungspraxis auf der einen Seite, CSSF-Anforderungen und das Luxemburger AML-Gesetz auf der anderen. Du kennst beide Welten und weißt, wo sie sich unterscheiden. UK-Erfahrung ist ein Plus. jobs.title: Senior Product Designer, Web3
jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Who we are&nbsp;</strong></h4> <p>We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!</p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><p><strong>Your mission&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>As a Senior Product Designer on Bitpanda’s Web3 team, you will architect the user experiences that power our next-generation crypto ecosystem, from asset-backed loans in the Bitpanda app to tokenised structured products in the Vision Wallet. You will transform complex, data-heavy financial workflows into seamless interfaces, navigating the unique challenges of a fast-moving, highly regulated space. Partnering tightly with engineering, product, and compliance teams, your designs will directly drive customer engagement, retention, and trust. You'll shape Bitpanda's newest business lines, using AI to go from idea to working prototypes in hours and to testing them with real customers within days.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design and develop end-to-end trading, investment, and Web3 interfaces across both mobile and web platforms</li> <li>Simplify highly complex financial products (such as tokenized financial derivatives) into intuitive, low-friction user experiences</li> <li>Conduct comprehensive user research, usability testing, and behavioral analysis to optimize funnel conversion, engagement, and drop-off rates</li> <li>Apply and continuously contribute to scalable design systems, ensuring consistency and performance across data-heavy interfaces</li> <li>Use AI to prototype, test and ship faster: build working, coded prototypes in hours, test them with customers within days, and keep our design system ready for engineers' AI coding tools to build from</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who you are</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven knowledge and experience in Product, UX, and UI Design, with a mandatory strong background in Crypto, Web3, or complex fintech products</li> <li>Expert in Figma and interaction design, and AI-native in how you work: you already use AI tools to build coded prototypes and test ideas fast.&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience simplifying complex financial concepts and workflows into accessible, user-centric designs</li> <li>Practical knowledge of working within regulated, fast-moving environments while maintaining high design delivery velocity</li> <li>A strong data-informed mindset with experience in continuous optimization based on user metrics, coupled with deep customer empathy</li> </ul> <p><br><br><strong>** This position is available remotely in one of our Hubs.</strong

But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI. Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech. What We Offer The people at Tacto are passionate about building the organization, growing themselves, and our product while having fun and being real. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: Your Impact Procurement is over 50% of revenue for industrial companies and their biggest lever for profitability. The hard part isn't the software. Every customer's reality is different: a different ERP, a different data model, decades of undocumented process. Generic platforms stall exactly there, and that's where most enterprise AI value quietly dies. At Tacto, the people who close that gap are Builders who work at the customer edge. You sit inside the customer's environment, build in their production data, and turn what you learn there into product. More than 300 industrial companies already run on Tacto, and every new one teaches us something the platform should do on its own. Your Tasks Prove it with their data. Show a prospect or customer what Tacto finds in their own spend, suppliers and parts, fast enough that the value is obvious. Build in customer environments. Data pipelines, agents and custom logic on top of the Tacto platform, in real production data, until the procurement team can actually work with the result. Be in the room, on site. Run workshops with buyers and key users, debug alongside their IT, and see how a company really buys instead of how the process documentation says it buys. Turn the edge into product. When you solve something twice, ship it into the platform so nobody has to solve it a third time. You're done when it drives revenue, not when the deployment is live. Automate your own job. If a step can be done by an agent, you build the agent and prove it works. Your Profile You've built something people relied on: software, automations, agents, or a technical project that real users used. You build with AI every day. Cursor, Claude, Codex and agents are your default, and you've built with LLMs against real, messy data. You're hands-on with data. SQL and Python at working level, or the drive to get there fast with AI as leverage. You thrive in messy environments. Incomplete requirements, undocumented data and conflicting stakeholders don't stop you. You earn customer trust. You explain technical decisions clearly, handle pushback, and don't over-promise. Early in your career? Good. We bet on people with a steep learning curve, and our senior Builders spend real time making others faster. Native-level German and fluent English, based in Munich, happy to travel across DACH. What This Role Is, and Isn't We want to be honest about what you are signing up for. jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Operations Technology (All Genders)
jobs.description: <h2>About the role: What's in the Box</h2> <p>The Logistics Tribe builds the systems powering end-to-end delivery across North America, Europe and Australia/New Zealand: getting fresh ingredients into our facilities, giving customers the best delivery options the network can support, and tracking every box to the customer's door. Today it is a single engineering team - two staff engineers, a data engineer and seven mid-to-senior engineers - led by the Director of Engineering, owning that software and keeping it running in production. You will join as an Engineering Manager and take line management of the seven.</p> <p>The work is operations-heavy and business-critical, spread across different subdomains. You won't own a fixed backlog in one corner of the domain; the team's scope follows where the business pressure is. That is reflected in how we work: rather than one fixed squad, the team organises into small, project-focused pods that form and dissolve as projects start and finish. In a typical sprint, your engineers might be spread across three projects with three different product managers.</p> <p>Strategy and technical direction are things we shape together - staff engineers, product managers and you all contributing, nobody working from a script handed down. You limit how many projects anyone carries, and you keep handovers clean so nobody becomes a single point of failure.</li> <li>Own the delivery health of your team's work together with the product managers and the engineers leading each project: realistic plans, sound quality, and systems that stay reliable once shipped.</li> <li>Hire and onboard well - you'll be building the team's balance of skills as projects and domains shift under you.</li> <li>Champion the engineering practices we care about: behaviour-driven tests for every business use case, and small iterations.</li> <li>Help shape tribe culture as part of the leadership team, in a setup that is deliberately flat and collaborative.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring: The Ingredients</h2> <ul> <li>At least 2 years leading mid-to-senior engineers in an agile environment, backed by 6+ years of total engineering experience - you've run development and growth conversations and seen people through to promotion.</li> <li>Comfort leading people through changing project boundaries - this is a team that reforms around projects, not one that sits still.</li> <li>A backend-leaning technical grounding - event-driven microservices, Kubernetes, Kafka, relational databases, CI/CD - with real BDD/TDD habits that make large refactorings safe. jobs.description: sensmore is a Berlin/Potsdam-based robotics startup delivering production-proven automation for industries where the world’s raw materials are extracted, moved, and processed. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. jobs.description: Hast du schon mal eine Person eingestellt und gewusst: Diese eine Entscheidung verändert die ganze Firma? Hast du schon mal erlebt, wie eine einzige falsche Besetzung ein kleines Team um Monate zurückwirft? Und hast du dir schon mal gewünscht, nicht die 30. Rolle des Jahres abzuarbeiten, sondern bei jeder Einstellung wirklich mitzugestalten, wohin ein Unternehmen wächst? Bei FINE DINE ist jede Einstellung genau das: ein Hebel. Wir sind heute 11 Leute und wachsen auf 15 bis 20. Bis 2030 wollen wir die FINE DINE Box in mehr als 100 Städte in Europa bringen. Jede Person, die du zu uns holst, entscheidet mit darüber, ob uns das gelingt. Du suchst aus, wer diesen Weg mit uns geht. Was uns wirklich ausmacht: Wir drei Founder denken seit Jahren an kaum etwas anderes als an FINE DINE. Bei uns zählt das Ergebnis, nicht wie viele Stunden jemand im Büro sitzt oder wie schön eine Präsentation aussieht. Entscheidungen fallen schnell, Wege sind kurz, und du arbeitest direkt mit uns Foundern zusammen. Du arbeitest People & Culture bei uns nicht in einem bestehenden System ab. Du baust es auf. Aufgaben Recruiting Ownership: Du verantwortest das Recruiting für ca. 5 Rollen pro Jahr, strategisch und operativ. Von der Bedarfsklärung mit uns Foundern über Stellenanzeigen und strukturierte Interviews bis zum Angebot. Active Sourcing: Du findest Key-Hires per Direktansprache über LinkedIn und dein Netzwerk, in der Region Ulm und darüber hinaus. Recruiting-System: Du baust das Fundament für schnelles und nachhaltiges Recruitment auf: Pipeline, Scorecards, Interviewleitfäden und KPIs wie Time-to-Hire, Response-Rate und Conversion. Sparringspartner für die Founder: Du berätst deine Hiring Manager auf Augenhöhe und mit Daten. Employer Branding & Content: Du machst FINE DINE als Arbeitgeber sichtbar. Du baust unsere LinkedIn-Präsenz von null auf, postest regelmäßig über Team, Kultur und unseren Alltag, holst das Team mit ins Boot und schreibst Stellenanzeigen, die zeigen, wer wir wirklich sind. Onboarding & Ansprechperson: Du bist Ansprechperson für unser Team und sorgst dafür, dass neue Kolleg:innen schnell ankommen und ab Tag 1 produktiv sind. People Operations: Du stimmst dich mit unserem Steuerbüro und der Lohnbuchhaltung ab und bist die erste Ansprechperson für alle HR-Themen im Team. Qualifikation Recruiting-Erfahrung: Du bringst Erfahrung im Recruiting mit, idealerweise in-house in einem Start-up oder Scale-up in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Foundern oder in einer Personalberatung. Active Sourcing: Direktansprache ist dein Steckenpferd. Du schreibst Nachrichten, auf die Menschen antworten, und kennst deine Conversion-Raten von Outreach bis Hire. Lernbereitschaft: Du willst mehr als „nur“ Recruiting und hast Lust, dir neue Themen wie Employer Branding, Payroll oder Onboarding eigenständig zu erarbeiten. Eigenverantwortung & Speed: Du arbeitest schnell, hands-on und eigenverantwortlich. Du lieferst in Tagen, nicht in Wochen, und misst dich an Ergebnissen statt an Aktivitäten. Datenkompetenz & Kommunikation: Du steuerst nach Zahlen, nicht nach Bauchgefühl, und hast Zielwerte wie Time-to-Hire im Kopf. Stressresistenz: Du bleibst ruhig, wenn mehrere Prozesse und Projekte parallel laufen und ein Wunschkandidat kurzfristig absagt. Ein Plus, aber kein Muss LinkedIn & Content: Du hast erste Erfahrung mit LinkedIn-Content oder Employer Branding. Falls nicht, lernst du bei uns, wie man Content strategisch aufbaut. Branchenerfahrung: Du kennst D2C, E-Commerce oder Premium-Consumer-Brands und hast Marketing-, Sales- oder Tech-Rollen besetzt. HR-Admin: Du hattest schon Berührun

Support compliance of FPGA, programmable logic, complex electronic hardware and electronic assemblies, as applicable to the individual programme. Assess COTS, reused or previously developed hardware and define appropriate certification and compliance activities. Support configuration management, problem reporting, change control and lifecycle data management required for certification. Perform compliance reviews, gap analyses and change-impact assessments and track findings through closure. Work closely with Hardware Development, Systems Engineering, Safety, Test & Verification and Configuration Management to integrate certification activities into the engineering lifecycle. Professional experience in airborne electronic hardware development, hardware verification, aerospace certification or development assurance. Strong practical knowledge of RTCA DO-254 / EUROCAE ED-80 and its application to airborne electronic hardware. Experience with hardware certification planning, requirements management, verification and compliance evidence. Good understanding of FPGA / CPLD or complex electronic hardware development, electronic hardware and PCB development, hardware requirements and design reviews, requirements-based verification, configuration management, change control, requirements traceability, verification independence, and COTS or reused hardware assessment. Experience creating or reviewing DO-254 lifecycle documents such as PHAC, HVP, HCMP and HAS is highly desirable. jobs.title: QA & Authorisation Handler
jobs.description: Turning risk into opportunity Human progress runs on a single trade: risk for opportunity. Every venture worth doing - a new business, a new home, an exciting trip - means accepting the chance it goes wrong. Insurance is what lets us take those chances anyway, and the claim is the moment it either delivers on that promise or fails to. We're rebuilding that moment. ClaimSorted is an AI-native claims solution for insurers and large corporates that resolves claims faster, fairer, and more reliably than the industry ever has. Handle risk that well, and people are free to take on more of it - that's how you push society toward opportunity: not by eliminating risk, but by making recovery so fast and certain it stops being a reason to hold back. We're one of the fastest-growing InsurTechs - scaling 10x YoY, processing hundreds of millions in claims payouts, and backed by the world's leading investors: Y Combinator, Atomico, and Eurazeo. What we are looking for We are looking for a confident, analytical and detail-focused QA & Authorisation Handler to join our Technical Claims Support Team. You will provide a key technical control across our claims operation, completing Quality Assurance reviews and reviewing claim settlements at the authorisation stage . As the final line of defence before a claim settlement is approved , you will be responsible for independently reviewing the claim, evidence, policy coverage and settlement calculation before making the decision to authorise, pass back or escalate . This requires confidence and strong technical judgement. You must be comfortable making decisions, challenging claim assessments where something does not look right and clearly explaining the reasoning behind your decision. The role goes beyond identifying individual errors. You will use findings from QA and authorisations to identify potential financial leakage, recurring handling issues, process and control gaps and emerging trends across the claims operation. You will be comfortable using data to understand where issues are occurring, identify root causes and turn findings into practical improvements to processes, controls, guidance and training. As ClaimSorted works across a range of insurance products and partners, you will need to be adaptable and confident moving between different products, policy wordings, processes and priorities while maintaining consistently high standards. As part of the wider Technical Claims Support Team, you will also support other technical claims activities where required. Responsibilities Review claim settlements at authorisation stage across all ClaimSorted products , acting as the final line of defence before payment is approved. Independently review policy coverage, supporting evidence and settlement calculations, making confident decisions to authorise, pass back or escalate . Complete Quality Assurance reviews across all products , ensuring claims are handled accurately, fairly and in line with policy, partner and internal requirements. Identify and prevent financial leakage , incorrect settlements and other customer or financial risks. Provide clear, constructive and evidence-based feedback to Claims Handlers, confidently challenging decisions where required. Use QA, authorisation and leakage data across products to identify trends, recurring errors, training needs and process or control gaps . Support improvements to claims processes, guidance and controls based on findings and root-cause analysis. Maintain accurate records of decisions and findings while effectively managing and prioritising QA and authorisation workloads. Build and maintain the technical knowledge required to work confidently across all ClaimSorted product lines, partners and processes . Work collaboratively across Claims Operations and the wider Technical Claims Support Team. Skills and Experience Required +2 years experience completing claim authorisations within an insurance claims team is essential , with responsibility

This team builds and maintains the payment rails that power Pleo's money movement, integrating with banks and payment partners to handle inbound and outbound bank transfers reliably and at scale. You'll be working on some of the most critical systems at Pleo: the infrastructure that guarantees that each financial transaction, whether incoming, outgoing, or internal, is processed and settled with absolute accuracy, on time, and with the resilience to recover gracefully when things go wrong. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including compliance, finance operations, and product to evolve Pleo's payment capabilities. Participate in code reviews, post-mortems, and provide mentorship to other engineers. Proactively address technical debt and guide the team through technical challenges and migrations. What you bring You'll thrive in this role if you have: Hands-on experience building payment integrations, bank APIs, payment scheme integrations, or financial messaging formats (ISO 20022, SWIFT, SEPA, Faster Payments, or similar). Strong understanding of payment flows end-to-end: payment initiation, routing, reconciliation, settlement, and exception/failure handling. Experience designing and operating highly available, resilient distributed systems with robust error recovery and observability. Expertise in server-side development, ideally Kotlin or Java, with strong experience in microservices and distributed systems. Proficiency with relational databases (PostgreSQL), cloud environments (AWS, Kubernetes), and observability tooling (e.g. Grafana). Awareness of payment compliance and regulatory considerations (e.g. AML, sanctions screening, PSD2) is a plus. Understanding of safeguarding of customer funds and the impact of money movement pipelines. jobs.title: Founding Engineer
jobs.description: About Share Share is a venture-backed startup building the global marketplace for bandwidth. We enable anyone to build their own programmable internet network, in seconds. Today, bandwidth is bought and sold through slow, private, one-off deals, with almost no price transparency. Only the largest tech companies have escaped this, by spending billions to build their own physical networks. Share is giving that power to everyone. Infrastructure providers sell their services in the Share Marketplace; giving builders, AI agents and enterprises the ability to build their own global backbone via an API layer. The path, the performance, how long they need it and paying only for what they use. The role We are hiring a Founding Engineer to take ownership of core platform architecture as we rebuild for a system roughly 50x the scale of what we had before. You'll design and scale distributed systems from scratch (this is deep systems-architecture work, not feature development on an existing system.) You will work directly with the Head of Development and a small team of engineers to ship production systems operating at global scale. Non-negotiable 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with real, hands-on ownership of designing and scaling a production system from scratch. You can describe specific production incidents at scale (what broke, why, and what you changed) not just system-design-interview theory. Deep TypeScript/Node.js expertise. You should be able to design a NestJS microservice from scratch, not just work in one. Strong PostgreSQL skills. You can design schemas for complex, high-throughput production data, write migrations, and reason about transaction isolation and locking. Experience with event-driven architectures (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar). You understand the difference between request-reply and fire-and-forget patterns and when to use each. You ship. You can take a spec document and turn it into production code without waiting for someone to break it into small tasks. Nice to have, not required : prior fintech/payments experience or blockchain/distributed-ledger exposure AI-augmented engineering (required mindset) We expect every engineer at Share to use AI tools as a daily part of their workflow. This is how we operate. Our entire project planning, specification, and documentation process runs through AI-assisted sessions. Our codebase includes AI-readable context files. We use Claude for architecture decisions, code review, spec generation, and technical writing. What this means for you: You already use AI coding assistants (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) daily and can articulate how they change your workflow. You are comfortable working with AI-generated specifications and can critically evaluate them, push back where they are wrong, and extend them where they are incomplete. You see AI as a force multiplier that lets a small team operate at the capacity of a much larger one. You are not threatened by it; you are faster because of it. You are willing to contribute to improving our AI-assisted workflows Compensation & Details: Competitive Salary & Equity package Additional Benefits Paid Business Travel when needed Ownership in a venture-backed early stage startup building the future of physical and digital infrastructure in Africa Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description: About us People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. It is not. It is a large number of people acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on with tools that have barely changed in decades. Nexcade builds AI agents for those people, starting in freight forwarding, a $210BN industry. Our agents are live in production with some of the leading global forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are expanding the platform deeper into the shipment lifecycle. We have raised $8.5M to make this a reality. Our founders, Dan and Tasho, spent years at Sedna and Palantir working with supply chain companies on problems like this one. We are backed by top VCs and angels who backed or founded Synthesia, n8n and other world-class companies. How we work Everybody codes, founders included. The whole company is technical, commercial team included, and runs on coding agents. Closely with customers and design partners, so what we ship changes how they operate. At pace. Fast cycles and quick iterations, on the product and on how we work. End to end. If you see something broken or missing, you have the freedom (and the responsibility) to fix it. In person, 4+ days a week in London. We value synchronous communication. Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly. Enjoy the journey. Hard problems, good colleagues. The role We are building the AI platform for freight forwarding and expanding our product surface, and we are hiring software engineers across product, AI and platform to do it. You will build products that do freight forwarding work alongside our customers' teams, operating across the entire shipment lifecycle. You will work across the stack in Python, TypeScript and React, and directly with customers and founders on what gets built. Everyone here works across the stack, but each engineer has a spike: the area where they set the bar for the team. You spend most of your time where yours is, and lean on your colleagues where theirs are. Product: You build best in class products for the core jobs in freight forwarding, one job at a time. You work as a design partner with our customers to understand the work deeply, turn that understanding into a product they would choose over anything else, and feed what you learn back into the platform everyone builds on. AI: You raise the ceiling on what our AI can do and the floor on how reliably it does it. That spans high volume tasks like classification and extraction and deep workflow tasks that run for hours. You design for performance, reliability, explainability and control, set up the gyms and evals to measure them, and build the harness that runs our agents in all of our products. Platform: You own the foundation every product stands on: the runtime for thousands of concurrent agents and workflows, the way they communicate and scale, the controls for how they access data with permissions that hold, and the observability to see and measure all of it. You ensure the rest of the team can move fast without fear. What we look for A spike, with evidence. Something you have been exceptional at and proof of it. We hire on slope rather than years, so there is no experience threshold in either direction. Strong fundamentals. In the AI-assisted era, having good technical judgement is key. You have shipped production systems people depend on, seen them fail and learned from it. High agency and ownership. You take an ambiguous problem, make a call, and see it through. Humility and learning velocity. You want to get better and you change your mind when the evidence says so. Interest in the problem. You do not need a freight background, but you need to find messy real-world operations interesting rather than a chore. jobs.title: Security Associate - Internship
jobs.description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. ⭐ SECURITY ASSOCIATE INTERNSHIP ⭐ Six-month end-of-studies internship in Paris. Looking for an end-of-studies internship where you do real cybersecurity work, not a side project nobody uses? Alan protects the health data of more than 1M members, and keeping it safe is part of everyday work here. You join the Security team as a full member for six months. Topics span from compliance and certifications to vulnerabilities, detection and incident response, and you have room to pick the ones where you can have the most impact. A dedicated coach guides you and supervises your thesis. The goal at the end is a full-time job at Alan. ⭐ DETAILED MISSIONS ⭐ Alan is opening new countries, and each one brings more audits, certifications and customer security reviews. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.</p></div><h3><strong>What Is The Role:</strong></h3> <p>We are on the lookout for a <strong>Principal Software Engineer</strong><span style="margin: 0px; padding: 0px;"><strong> </strong></span>to join our <strong>Elasticsearch - Distributed Systems team </strong>and focus on how Elasticsearch provides scale, performance, and resilience, especially in the context of our Serverless offering. You will be tackling deep distributed systems challenges in how nodes in an Elasticsearch cluster communicate, and how data are indexed, allocated, and managed across nodes.&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>What You Will Be Doing:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Leveraging your deep distributed systems expertise to design, build, and operate core pieces of our next-generation Serverless Elasticsearch offering, directly impacting the experience of customers worldwide.</li> <li>Improving Elasticsearch’s components that support concurrent and consistent indexing across multiple machines.</li> <li>Maintaining our cluster coordination system to keep performance high even though nodes come and go from the cluster and data moves around, while maintaining the safety and liveness properties of the system as a whole.</li> <li>Pushing the limits on the number of shards, nodes, and petabytes that Elasticsearch can handle today.</li> <li>Looking into all kinds of issues, including performance or concurrency issues, and proposing solutions.</li> <li>Supporting our support engineers with the harder problems.</li> <li>Owning operational investigations end-to-end, until performance or stability issues are successfully resolved.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What You Bring:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You have a deep background in distributed systems and consensus algorithms.</li> <li>You have strong skills in core Java and are conversant in the standard library of data structures and concurrency constructs, as well as newer language features.</li> <li>You have a deep technical proficiency in algorithms.</li> <li>You have experience building large-scale distributed systems, rather than making use of off-the-shelf services.&nbsp;</li> <li>You have experience building and debugging complex features with a broad impact, running on multiple machines.</li> <li>You are able to own projects from beginning to end. Recognising the need for innovation in the traditional employee insurance model we are set to revolutionize the employee insurance industry. We help companies support people before and after they get sick and to make more of their time. Our insurance solutions reduce monotonous and manual work for employees, doctors, HR & payroll managers. As we strive to lead a technology-driven transformation, we put employees first.   At grape we pride ourselves on our people and our culture. We continue to grow fast and that’s where you come in. Our team is dynamic, diverse and full of creative ideas. Want to join? We can’t wait to get to know you! Your role As Head of Insurance Supply, you will own grape’s carrier and reinsurance partnerships. You will build and diversify our capacity panel, secure the structures behind existing and new products, and ensure our insurance supply grows with the business. Today, this responsibility is led by our CEOs. You will take it over, build it into a dedicated function and represent Insurance Supply as a member of grape’s Leadership Team. What you’ll do: 1. Build and diversify our capacity panel Develop grape’s capacity strategy for Switzerland and Liechtenstein. Identify, qualify, negotiate with and onboard new carriers and reinsurers. Lead relationships from the first conversation through due diligence, commercial negotiation and signed agreement. Secure the contracted capacity required for grape’s annual business plan and written commitments for the following year. Diversify the panel to support growth, enable new products and reduce concentration risk.   2. Build strong carrier partnerships Own carrier and reinsurer relationships at operational, commercial and executive level. Establish a clear governance cadence, including operational reviews, strategic meetings and annual capacity negotiations. Own commercial terms, contracts, renewals, outsourcing agreements and service levels. Monitor partnership performance, resolve issues early and build relationships that grow over time. Represent grape credibly across the insurance, reinsurance and broking market.   3. Shape products and build the function Design and secure the carrier and reinsurance structures required for new products. Evaluate pricing, loss ratios, reserving, commissions, capital requirements and solvency implications. Work closely with Actuarial, Underwriting, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Product and Distribution. Own the Insurance Supply strategy, priorities, OKRs, processes and reporting. Provide the Leadership Team with a clear view of capacity coverage, pipeline and risk. Hire and lead a Carrier Partnerships Manager as the function grows. What you’ll bring: At least eight years of insurance experience, including carrier partnerships, MGA capacity management, programme business, reinsurance broking or business development at a carrier. A demonstrated track record of taking capacity relationships from initial contact through negotiation to a signed binding authority, treaty or comparable agreement. Strong commercial judgement and the confidence to negotiate with senior stakeholders across carriers, reinsurers, MGAs and brokers. A strong understanding of insurance portfolio economics, including loss ratios, reserving, pricing, capacity and capital implications. Experience building long-term external partnerships and a relevant network across the carrier, reinsurance or broking market. The ability to move between strategy, relationship building, negotiation and operational detail. Fluent English. Strong advantage: Experience working within an MGA or directly with MGA and programme structures. Knowledge of Swiss and Liechtenstein employee insurance, particularly KTG, UVG and UVG-Z. jobs.title: Applied ML Engineer/Data Scientist
jobs.description: 🍇 About grape:    Our entrepreneurial spirit drives us in what we do and what we are passionate about. Our mission is to become the premier health partner in the insurance business. Recognising the need for innovation in the traditional employee insurance model we are set to revolutionize the employee insurance industry. We help companies support people before and after they get sick and to make more of their time. Our insurance solutions reduce monotonous and manual work for employees, doctors, HR & payroll managers. As we strive to lead a technology-driven transformation, we put employees first.   At grape we pride ourselves on our people and our culture. We continue to grow fast and that’s where you come in. Our team is dynamic, diverse and full of creative ideas. Want to join? We can’t wait to get to know you! Your role Our data and tech give us an edge in risk assessment, pricing and premium calculation. This role turns that into accurate models that support our carrier partners and our growth, builds tuned models where they beat rules and off-the-shelf LLMs in claims (triage, intervention, return-to-work, fraud), and responsibly explores how data can help employees stay healthy through grape Care. We’re looking for an applied ML engineer / data scientist to build predictive models from the ground up on real, regulated insurance data. You’ll own problems end to end, from effective-dated records to production, in a domain where correctness and responsible use genuinely matter. Starting points include pricing and risk, portfolio monitoring, claims and payment patterns, triage and return-to-work, absence, and fraud detection. grape sits on a rich dataset, though, and you’ll help find the next high-value use cases. You’re candid about what the data can support, and you propose simpler approaches when they’re the right answer. This is not an LLM role. LLM and agent workflows and document extraction sit with our engineering teams, and you’ll use their outputs as features. What you'll do: Build and validate models Own the full model lifecycle: feature engineering, training, evaluation, explainability, deployment, and drift monitoring. Backtest on the historical book and run models in shadow mode alongside human decision-makers, reporting where and why they disagree. Produce audit-ready validation and governance documentation that actuarial, compliance, and carrier partners can review. Platform and MLOps Deploy models on grape’s cloud platform within strict security and data-residency requirements for health data. Set up experiment tracking, model versioning, and production monitoring, partnering with engineering on integration. Shape the problem space Identify and prioritize high-value use cases as you explore the dataset, rather than waiting to be handed problems. Turn ambiguous business questions into well-defined, measurable modelling. Responsible & explainable by design Build privacy, fairness, and explainability into every model that touches personal or health data, working with compliance and legal on nDSG/GDPR boundaries. Models support decisions; accountable owners make them. Pricing, reserving, and claims work requires licensed-actuary sign-off, and any automation requires governance approval first. Collaborate Explain model behavior and limits to underwriting, claims, actuarial, and compliance teams. What you'll need: Strong applied ML and statistics: supervised and unsupervised learning, anomaly detection, time-series, and survival/duration modeling. Proven experience building models on real-world, relational, effective-dated data, including imbalanced outcomes. Fluent Python (pandas, scikit-learn, a modern ML stack) and strong SQL. Solid grasp of validation, calibration, and explainability (e.g. SHAP). Production MLOps: experiment tracking, versioning, and drift monitoring. Sound judgment on data privacy and modelling. Fluent English. Bias for action, ownership, and clear cross-functional commu

jobs.title: Sales Manager CH, KI-Software für Psychotherapeut:innen
jobs.description: Über VIA HealthTech VIA macht aus einer Therapiesitzung ein fertiges Sitzungsprotokoll und aus Sitzungsprotokollen vollständige psychologische Berichte. Arbeit, die Therapeut:innen bisher mehrere Stunden pro Woche gekostet hat. Wir sind die marktführende KI-Assistenz für Psychotherapeut:innen. Über 4.000 Psychotherapeut:innen im DACH-Raum nutzen VIA, wir verarbeiten Hunderttausende Sitzungen pro Monat. Wir sind nach ISO 27001:2022 zertifiziert und verfügen über ein BSI-C5-Testat. Wir sind ein multidisziplinäres Team in Berlin-Mitte. Marktführer in Deutschland zu sein, ist erst der Startpunkt. Die Schweiz ist unser nächster Markt, und du baust ihn mit auf. Die Rolle Du bist unsere erste Person im Schweizer Markt. Du baust die Pipeline von Grund auf, entwickelst das Playbook und führst es selbst aus. In Deutschland läuft unser Funnel vor allem über Webinare: Therapeut:innen melden sich an, testen VIA 14 Tage und buchen selbst. Du findest heraus, was davon in der Schweiz funktioniert und was anders laufen muss: Qualifizierung am Telefon, Cold-Calling, andere Outbound- und Inbound-Kanäle, Verbände, Weiterbildungsinstitute, grössere Organisationen als eigener Kanal. Du testest, misst und skalierst, wo der Hebel am grössten ist. Du arbeitest eng mit Marketing an Zielgruppen, Kampagnen und Botschaften für den Schweizer Markt und gibst direkt zurück, was im Gespräch wirklich zieht. Die Rolle ist senior gedacht. Wenn du mid-level, aber aussergewöhnlich schnell und hungrig bist, bewirb dich trotzdem. Deine Aufgaben Den Markt öffnen. Du identifizierst die wichtigsten Zielgruppen in der Schweiz: selbstständige psychologische Psychotherapeut:innen, Psychiater:innen, Organisationen der psychologischen Psychotherapie, Ambulatorien und Kliniken. Du priorisierst, wo wir zuerst gewinnen. Leads in Kund:innen verwandeln. Qualifizierungsgespräche, Webinare, Demos, Follow-up während der Testphase, Abschluss. Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für Schweizer Kund:innen. Neue Kanäle erschliessen. Berufsverbände wie FSP, ASP und SBAP, Weiterbildungsinstitute, Fachveranstaltungen und Kongresse. Erstansprache per Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn, wo sie sich lohnt. Playbook bauen, während du verkaufst. jobs.title: Homologation & Certification Engineer, Energy Systems
jobs.description: About EH Energy Engineering EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners. To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready. This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland . We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements , so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate . Key responsibilities Certification strategy and project management Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine) Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT) Safety engineering and risk analysis Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882) Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports Compliance and technical documentation Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports Write and review user, installation, operation and maintenance manuals, safety instructions and labelling Maintain the standards register and assess the impact of new or revised standards Manage certification change control: assess design changes for impact on existing certificates Collaboration and continuous improvement Act as the internal authority on certification scope: ensure in-service conformity of series production with certified designs, and support procurement and supply chain on material and packaging compliance (e.g. RoHS, packaging regulations). Support design reviews and supplier qualification, including component certificates (ATEX, PED, electrical) Standards and regulatory scope The role covers, but is not limited to, the frameworks below. Working knowledge of most is expected; deep expertise in several is required IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1:2021, ISO 16110-1 and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 Required qualifications Master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, process or safety engineering, or equivalent 5+ years in product certification, compliance or safety engineering for complex electromechanical or process equipment (energy, gas, process, machinery or marine) Direct experience with hydrogen or fuel cell systems and the IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1 or ISO 16110 Proven track record of taking products through CE marking and third-party certification with notified bodies or NRTLs Hands-on experience leading FMEA, HAZOP and risk assessments, and documenting them to auditor standard Solid know

jobs.title: Stagiair(e) Digitale Transformatie & Publieke Innovatie
jobs.description: Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot Digitalisering verandert de manier waarop overheden en publieke organisaties werken, besluiten nemen en dienstverlening organiseren. Tegelijkertijd groeit de behoefte aan praktische oplossingen, toepasbare kennis en slimme instrumenten die organisaties helpen om complexe digitale vraagstukken beheersbaar te maken. Wil jij ervaring opdoen binnen een toonaangevend adviesbureau en bijdragen aan vraagstukken op het gebied van digitalisering, data, digitale autonomie en publieke innovatie? Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit: Ondersteunen bij onderzoeken, analyses en adviesopdrachten. Voorbereiden en ondersteunen van workshops, werksessies en bijeenkomsten voor opdrachtgevers. Meewerken aan de ontwikkeling van praktische handreikingen, methodieken en kennisproducten. Uitwerken van onderzoeksresultaten naar concrete producten voor opdrachtgevers. Actualiseren en verrijken van onze website, publicaties en online kennisproducten. Structureren, actualiseren en verder ontwikkelen van bestaande kenniscollecties tot een deelbare kenniscatalogus. Uitvoeren van markt- en deskresearch naar ontwikkelingen op het gebied van digitalisering, data en digitale autonomie. Ondersteunen bij de doorontwikkeling van onze digitale-autonomie-quickscan en andere proposities. Afhankelijk van jouw interesses en achtergrond draai je bovendien mee in lopende adviesprojecten. Hier kom je terecht Berenschot is een zelfstandig en onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. We dragen bij aan vooruitgang in organisaties en de maatschappij met onze adviezen en oplossingen. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je invloed hebt op de projecten die je uitvoert. We streven altijd naar verrassende en vernieuwende oplossingen, wat ons uniek maakt. Met een open en informele cultuur, samenwerking tussen verschillende vakgebieden en veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid vanaf dag één, krijg je de kans om te ontdekken wat je belangrijk vindt, waar je kracht ligt en waarin jij je wilt ontwikkelen. Ons team ondersteunt organisaties bij vraagstukken rond digitale strategie, informatiehuishouding, digitale autonomie, datastrategie, cybersecurity en continuiteit, governance, dienstverlening en organisatieontwikkeling. Daarbij combineren we inhoudelijke kennis van technologie met inzicht in recht, bestuur, beleid en organisatie. Vanaf dag één krijg je verantwoordelijkheid en lever je een concrete bijdrage aan opdrachten en producten. Daarnaast: Heb je affiniteit met digitalisering en maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Ben je analytisch sterk en nieuwsgierig. Werk je zelfstandig en gestructureerd. jobs.title: Data & AI Governance Consultant
jobs.description: Help organisaties om data en AI verantwoord, betrouwbaar en effectief in te zetten. Data- en AI-governance is meer dan beleid en procedures. Het zorgt ervoor dat organisaties grip krijgen op hun data, betere beslissingen nemen en AI op een verantwoorde manier kunnen inzetten. Bij adesso helpen we organisaties om datagedreven en AI-gedreven werken duurzaam te organiseren. Niet door alleen modellen en policies te introduceren, maar door governance te verbinden aan businesswaarde, adoptie en de dagelijkse praktijk. Als Data & AI Governance Consultant help jij klanten om structuur aan te brengen, eigenaarschap te organiseren en hun datamanagement en AI-governance verder te professionaliseren. Je vertaalt complexe vraagstukken naar praktische oplossingen die daadwerkelijk werken. Jouw rol Jij brengt structuur in complexe data- en AI-vraagstukken. Je helpt organisaties om hun governanceprocessen te verbeteren, verantwoordelijkheden helder te maken en data beter te benutten. Je werkt zelfstandig aan analyses, workshops en verbeterinitiatieven en schakelt daarbij met stakeholders uit business en IT. Samen met collega's en klanten vertaal je strategische doelstellingen naar concrete acties. Je krijgt de ruimte om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, je expertise te verdiepen en steeds meer zelfstandig klanten te adviseren. Wat je doet Data- en AI-governance Je adviseert klanten over data governance, datamanagement en verantwoord gebruik van AI. Je helpt bij het ontwerpen en implementeren van governance operating models, inclusief rollen, verantwoordelijkheden en besluitvorming. Je voert zelfstandig maturity assessments uit en vertaalt de resultaten naar concrete verbeteradviezen. Je ondersteunt bij het ontwikkelen van datastrategieën, governanceprincipes, policies en praktische roadmaps. Je helpt organisaties om data ownership en data stewardship goed in te richten. Data quality, metadata & AI Je analyseert en verbetert processen rondom datakwaliteit, metadata en data lineage. Je helpt bij het definiëren van kwaliteitsafspraken, KPI's en verantwoordelijkheden. Je werkt samen met data engineers, architecten en andere specialisten om governancevraagstukken te vertalen naar werkbare oplossingen. Je onderzoekt hoe AI en automatisering datamanagementprocessen kunnen verbeteren. Je houdt rekening met privacy, security, Responsible AI en relevante wet- en regelgeving, zoals de EU AI Act. Consultancy & stakeholdermanagement Je faciliteert workshops met business- en IT-stakeholders om behoeften, knelpunten en verbeterkansen in kaart te brengen. Je vertaalt zakelijke doelstellingen naar concrete governance-initiatieven en meetbare resultaten. Je presenteert analyses, bevindingen en aanbevelingen op een duidelijke en overtuigende manier. Je ondersteunt klanten bij het invoeren van nieuwe processen en werkwijzen en helpt draagvlak te creëren. Je signaleert kansen voor aanvullende dienstverlening en bespreekt deze met je team. Samenwerking & ontwikkeling Je neemt zelfstandig verantwoordelijkheid voor onderdelen van klantprojecten en bewaakt de voortgang en kwaliteit van je werkzaamheden. Je werkt nauw samen met collega's uit verschillende disciplines en schakelt tijdig wanneer ondersteuning nodig is. Je gebruikt AI-tools waar ze waarde toevoegen en beoordeelt de uitkomsten kritisch, met aandacht voor vertrouwelijkheid en dataveiligheid. Je deelt kennis, begeleidt waar mogelijk minder ervaren collega's en draagt bij aan de ontwikkeling van onze dienstverlening. Wat jij meebrengt Je bent analytisch sterk, nieuwsgierig en weet complexe onderwerpen begrijpelijk te maken. Je vindt het leuk om met klanten samen te werken en krijgt energie van het verbeteren van processen en organisaties. Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in Bedrijfskunde, Informatiekunde, Informatica of een vergelijkbare richting. Minimaal 3 jaar relevante ervaring binnen data governance, datamanagement of dataconsultancy. Kennis van data governance, data quality

jobs.title: Medior AI Engineer
jobs.description: Van slimme AI-modellen naar oplossingen die écht werken. Een AI-model bouwen is één ding. Zorgen dat het betrouwbaar draait, gekoppeld is aan echte data en waarde toevoegt bij een klant: daar wordt het interessant. Bij adesso werk je aan AI-oplossingen die verder gaan dan experimenten, van machine learning en MLOps tot generatieve AI, LLM's en agents. Je bouwt, implementeert en verbetert oplossingen die organisaties echt gebruiken. Wat ga je doen? Als Medior AI Engineer werk je samen met senior AI Engineers en Forward Deployed Engineers aan klantprojecten. Je pakt zelfstandig onderdelen op en groeit in architectuur en end-to-end verantwoordelijkheid. AI ontwikkelen: je bouwt ML-modellen, LLM-toepassingen en agentic workflows. Van idee naar productie: je bouwt data- en ML-pipelines, automatiseert deployments en zorgt voor monitoring en betrouwbaarheid. Slim integreren: je koppelt AI aan bestaande systemen, API's en cloud- en dataplatformen. Meedenken met de klant: je vertaalt vraagstukken naar praktische, schaalbare oplossingen. Kennis delen: je legt herbruikbare patronen vast en deelt wat je leert met je collega's. Projecten die verder gaan dan het model We richten ons op retail en e-commerce, finance en utilities. Denk aan: Prognoses waar planners op durven te sturen, van retailassortiment tot netbelasting. Intelligente documentverwerking, zoals KYC-dossiers of inspectierapporten, met herleidbare bronnen. Agents die werk voorbereiden in klantenservice en backoffice, met evals en guardrails. Computer vision, zoals in de fitnessbranche, waar we onveilige situaties in onbemande 24/7-locaties herkennen. De uitdaging zit niet alleen in het model, maar ook in betrouwbaarheid, integratie en de werking in de praktijk. Je kiest steeds de techniek die bij het probleem past. Wat breng je mee? Ervaring met het ontwikkelen en in productie brengen van ML- of GenAI-oplossingen. Goede kennis van Python, SQL en machine learning. Ervaring met MLOps en/of LLM's, RAG en AI-agents. Kennis van minimaal één cloudplatform (Azure, AWS of GCP) en een dataplatform zoals Databricks, Snowflake of Fabric. Je werkt met coding agents en beoordeelt kritisch wat ze opleveren. Je denkt vanuit de klantvraag en legt technische keuzes helder uit. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels. Wat dit níet is Geen individuele detachering. Je werkt aan projecten namens adesso, met een team achter je. Geen notebook-kerkhof. Een model is pas af als het in productie draait en gebruikt wordt. Geen GenAI omdat het kan. Soms is een klassiek model beter, soms een LLM; jij kiest wat past. Geen werk op afroep. Je denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee, niet pas als het ontwerp al vastligt. Het team Je wordt onderdeel van ons AI Engineering-team: AI engineering consultants in twee rollen. De Forward Deployed AI Engineer (FDE) is eigenaar van het klantprobleem en ontwerpt de oplossing, inclusief de agentic architectuur. Jij gaat als AI Engineer de diepte in op bouw, data, MLOps en schaal, en denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee over de juiste aanpak. Je krijgt ruimte om je eigen werk vorm te geven, maar je bent nooit alleen verantwoordelijk voor alle specialismen. Heb je diepe kennis van finance, retail of utilities en wil je dichter op de klant zitten? Kijk dan ook naar onze FDE-vacatures. Twijfel je? Solliciteer dan gewoon; we kijken samen welke rol het best past. Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen. Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt. We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief. Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen. AI-native: wij

jobs.title: Teamleider Electromagnetic Warfare (m/v/x)
jobs.description: Ben jij die ambitieuze Teamleider / R&D engineer die graag helpt om civiele en militaire vliegtuigen veilig, duurzaam en competitief te laten vliegen? jobs.title: Software Engineer - Optimisation Team
jobs.description: Role - Software Engineer - Optimisation Team Company - iwell - Harmonizing Clean Energy Location - Utrecht About iwell At iwell, we are all about reinforcing energy security. We help European businesses become more energy independent. With growing regulations, extreme price volatility and rising grid issues, they need to be resilient. It is time to take charge and think ahead. We deliver energy management solutions that ensure that businesses are always in control of their energy. Our in-house developed EMS and modular battery storage drive profit through sustainability, making businesses future-proof.  We are a fast-growing international team of bold, talented individuals. From engineers and software developers to creative thinkers and customer-focused business developers. No matter what your strong suit is, we always are looking for people who are determined to make a positive impact. The Role The Optimisation team builds the Python applications that decide what our customers' energy assets should do, and when. Batteries, EV fleets, solar and grid connections all come together in our optimiser, and the team turns prices, forecasts and constraints into schedules and decisions that run in production every day. Much of this work has an operations-research flavour, and the problems rarely arrive neatly defined.. They arrive as a customer who needs their vans charged by 6:00 at the lowest cost or a battery whose value depends on the hour. We're looking for someone who is comfortable across that whole path: understanding the real-world problem, shaping it into something a computer can solve, and shipping and operating the result. You don't need to be an OR specialist. You do need to be a strong Python engineer who enjoys messy, concrete problems. Success in this role means being able to: Take a loosely defined operational problem and turn it into working, maintainable production code. Work with data and models (optimisation, forecasting or plain statistics) without losing sight of the engineering. What you will do Create charging schedules for EV fleets that minimise electricity costs while guaranteeing every vehicle is ready when it needs to be. This means modelling tariffs, grid limits and departure times, and handling what happens when reality deviates from the plan. Calculate the value of each kWh produced or consumed, so that batteries, solar and flexible loads are steered by what energy is actually worth at that moment, and customers can see where their savings come from. Build forecasting models that predict operational issues before they happen, to maximise asset uptime and reduce the number of support tickets our Operations team has to handle. Take your work all the way to production: packaging, deployment, monitoring and bugfixing. Work with the rest of the Optimisation team on the shared tooling, data pipelines and modelling conventions the team uses.. What are looking for 5+ years of production Python development experience, writing clean, tested, maintainable code. A proven ability to translate real-world problems into working code. A pragmatic mindset: you choose the boring, well-understood solution when it's the right one, and you know when it isn't. Strong communication skills and a habit of documenting your work. Fluency in English is required. Weekly working hours of 32-40 hours  Coming into the office 3-4 days per week Bonus points for None of these are required. We'd rather hire a strong engineer and teach the domain than the other way around. Experience with a modelling library such as cvxpy or Pyomo, or other operations research experience.. Time-series forecasting in production, or basic MLOps: keeping models trained, monitored and honest. Data analysis experience Energy, battery or electricity domain knowledge: tariffs, grid constraints, day-ahead and imbalance markets. The willingness to take on a People lead role in the team. jobs.title: Productmanager Parts & Tyres
jobs.description: Ben jij commercieel ingesteld, analytisch sterk en heb je interesse in techniek en automotive? BAS Parts & Tyres is een grote speler in de internationale handel van truckonderdelen en banden. We leveren nieuwe, gebruikte en gereviseerde onderdelen aan klanten in meer dan 100 landen. Van complete motoren met meer dan 700 pk tot truckcabines die in containers de hele wereld overgaan: bij ons draait alles op grote schaal! Als Productmanager Parts & Tyres ben jij verantwoordelijk voor de verdere ontwikkeling en groei van jouw eigen assortiment. Je analyseert de markt, onderhoudt contact met leveranciers en bepaalt welke producten interessant zijn om in te kopen. Je krijgt de verantwoordelijkheid om jouw eigen productgroepen verder uit te bouwen. jobs.title: Stage Finance & Control
jobs.description: Studenten opgelet: Stage Finance & Control beschikbaar!  Wil jij een kijkje in de keuken van een internationale organisatie? Onderdeel zijn van ons finance team waarbij je leert over diverse finance aspecten? En ben je pro-actief, leergierig en hou je ook wel van een geintje op zijn tijd? Lees dan snel verder! Dit is P1 P1 Travel is het grootste sportevenementen Ticketing bureau van Europa en wij werken officieel samen met de grootste voetbalclubs, stadions en toernooien ter wereld. Denk aan clubs als Manchester United, Liverpool, FC Barcelona en SSC Napoli, maar ook de Olympische spelen, Formule 1 en Wimbledon. Wij brengen zakelijke en particuliere klanten naar het evenement van hun dromen. Jij kunt hier onderdeel van uitmaken in de vorm van een stage bij ons Finance team.  Feeling met sport en cijfers? Dan wordt deze stage je grootste hobby! Het finance team  Het zeskoppige finance team, onder leiding van Martijn, draagt met elkaar zorg voor alle financiële processen binnen de organisatie. Zoals je je wellicht kunt voorstellen is de event/travelbranche een dynamisch speelveld waarbij geen dag hetzelfde is. Aan het finance team de taak om in samenwerking met de rest van de organisatie te zorgen voor kloppende cijfers waarop gestuurd kan worden. Finance & Control stage  Gedurende je stage zal je compleet onderdeel zijn van het team en zorgen we voor een gevarieerd takenpakket. Je eerste weken staan in het teken van kennismaken met onze processen en werkwijzes. Daarna zul je aan de slag gaan met je eigen takenpakket. Hierbij kun je denken aan: Maken van periodieke en ad hoc rapportages;   Meewerken aan financiële maand- en jaarafsluitingen; Uitvoeren van checks en controles op o.a juistheid en volledigheid van financiële data en processen;  Maken van resultaatboekingen op events en het analyseren daarvan. Naast het op doen van waardevolle ervaring in de organisatie gaan we graag met je in gesprek over grote en uitdagende projecten die P1 en jou verder helpt in de ontwikkeling. Bijvoorbeeld het zelf opzetten van managementrapportages.  Jouw profiel  Je volgt momenteel een financiële studie in de richting van Accountancy, Bedrijfseconomie, Bedrijfsadministratie, Finance & Control o.i.d. en bent op zoek naar een meewerkstage per januari/februari 2027. Je bent pro-actief, wil zoveel mogelijk leren en steekt graag de handen uit de mouwen. Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal. Mooi meegenomen als je zelf ook een passie hebt voor sport, dat hebben wij namelijk ook!  Waar kom je terecht? We zijn gevestigd in het mooie Leiden en je komt terecht in een gezellig én ambitieus bedrijf waar geen dag hetzelfde is. We bestaan momenteel uit een groep van 80 collega’s en werken elk semester met een leuke groep van stagiaires verdeeld over verschillende afdelingen. Je zult dus zeker niet de enige zijn die van start gaat.  Dit krijg jij ervoor terug! Naast een afwisselende stage en goede begeleiding wordt er verder goed voor je gezorgd. Denk hierbij aan een gaaf kantoor voorzien van alle gemakken, verzorgde lunch, sportmogelijkheden en de vetste uitjes met de hele toko. Elke stagiair die wij hebben gehad kijkt terug op een onvergetelijke tijd.  ''It’s all about unforgettable experiences!'' Enthousiast geworden? Goed om te horen! Laat snel van je horen via de solliciteerknop door je CV en een motivatie te sturen. Is deze stage niet helemaal wat je zoekt? Check dan zeker ook nog even de andere stagevacatures. jobs.description: Build with us Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe. Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow, with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable. With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions. Let's build together. Your impact The Planning & Analysis domain empowers the organisation with accurate, granular insights and drives proactive decision making that stays aligned with our growth plans and cost envelope. This role is fundamental in connecting long term workforce strategy to daily execution. You will translate hiring, attrition and spend signals into clear guidance for the People & Places (P&P) team, talent acquisition and the business leaders they support. You will be the trusted business partner and numbers person for P&P leadership, helping them prioritise where to focus and how to measure success. What you'll ship Own how Mollie tracks, measures and forecasts headcount, including the headcount model, hiring plan, attrition and open role view, and the link between headcount and budget. Lead the analytical response to our most important workforce questions, such as sizing hiring needs, stress testing plan assumptions, and building the case for new teams and locations. Build and own models that break headcount and people cost down into their key drivers (hiring pace, attrition, mix, seniority, location), giving P&P and senior leaders the visibility to prioritise and act with confidence. Walk P&P through the trends in people data and the story behind them, including spend and other relevant metrics such as People OPEX, Places costs and vendor spend. Own the people and headcount view end to end in our monthly business reviews and in the annual planning cycle. What you'll bring 3 to 5 years of experience in FP&A, workforce planning or people analytics, ideally within a high growth fintech, tech or payments company. Your academic background is in a quantitative or business field. You are very comfortable using AI tooling in your daily work, and this is a must. You use it to accelerate your output, pressure test your thinking, automate recurring work and remove the grunt work that gets in the way of insight. Strong modelling skills in Google Sheets or Excel, and familiarity with HRIS and data visualisation tools (HiBob, Workday, Omni or similar). You can reason about headcount, attrition, cost per head and hiring funnel metrics without the concepts needing to be explained. Experience with Pigment, our planning tool, or with a comparable planning platform (Anaplan, Adaptive, or similar). You are action oriented by nature. Your analysis does not stop at describing what happened. You formulate a recommendation and stand behind it. You handle sensitive people data with discretion and good judgement. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step. No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.
